Flattened copy of orcad_import:LDO_SOT23-5_3 (same pinout as U1/U2 ME6211)

footprints.geometry_source: Club-internal IL-G footprint convention (IL-G-2P/3P: 1.016 mm drill, 1.524 x 3.048 mm oval pads, pin 1 at +X numbered toward -X, outline y -2.35..8.5) extended to 4 positions with body length (n-1)*2.5+3. Courtyard, F.Fab outline and pin-1 marker added. Outline not verified against a JAE S3L2 drawing.

mating_face.basis: Right-angle header (user confirmed S3L2, club convention); the club outline extends from the pin row toward +y (to 8.5 mm), taken as the housing/cable opening side.

footprints.geometry_source: Espressif camera sub-board Allegro footprint (imported): 15 contacts at local y=-0.9, hold-down lands 16/17 at y~+1.25, body to y=+3

mating_face.basis: contact tails at local -y; hold-down tabs, housing and cable opening toward +y. The Espressif reference PCB puts this side at the board edge.

footprints.geometry_source: Espressif camera sub-board Allegro footprint (imported): 24 contacts at local y=-0.625, mounting pads 25/26 at y=+1.95, actuator silk line at y=+3.2

mating_face.basis: XUNPU FPC 0.5PH H2.0 drawing (top view): contact tails on one side, housing 5.12 mm deep with the FPC slot and flip lid on the opposite side, i.e. +y from the tail row (pads at y=-0.625, mounting pads at y=+1.95).
